faq.q: Is the trial lesson really free?
faq.a: Yes. Your first lesson is free, with no payment details and no obligation. If it isn't the right fit, you simply walk away.

faq.q: Which subjects and curriculums do you cover?
faq.a: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Statistics, English, Economics and Computer Science. We teach Matric and Intermediate (FSc, ICS, ICom) for every Pakistani board, O Level, A Level, IGCSE, GCSE and IB, Australian Years 4–12 (NAPLAN, HSC, VCE) and university courses.

faq.q: Do you prepare students for entry tests?
faq.a: Yes. We prepare students for MDCAT, ECAT, NUST NET, FAST, GIKI, PIEAS, LUMS, NTS / NAT, ETEA and SAT, from full prep courses to last-minute crash courses, with timed practice papers and score tracking.

faq.q: How do you choose my child's tutor?
faq.a: We don't leave it to chance or a search filter. Our team matches a tutor to the subject, curriculum or test, your child's level and learning style, and your preferred times. If the fit isn't right, we'll switch tutors for free.
Our team is based in Pakistan and teaches students in Pakistan and abroad, including the UK, Australia, Canada and the Gulf. Lessons are always scheduled in your own timezone.
Lessons run live, one-to-one, by video call with a shared whiteboard. All you need is a laptop or tablet with a camera and a stable internet connection.

faq.q: Can we cancel or reschedule a lesson?
faq.a: Yes. Reschedule or cancel with at least 24 hours' notice. There are no lock-in contracts.

faq.q: How will I know it's working?
faq.a: You'll get notes after every lesson and a written progress report every month showing strengths, gaps and the plan ahead. For entry tests, we also share your practice-test scores.

faq.q: Can I teach with SAS Tutors?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Teach with us" at the top of the page to apply. We review every application, then hold a short interview and a demo lesson.
